newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Bank of Baroda cuts prime lending rate-PTI. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: India's Bank of Baroda cuts prime lending rate-PTI. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: India's state-run Bank of Baroda cut its prime lending rate to 15.5 percent from 16 percent, effective on October 1, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Tuesday. (Corrects day from Thursday)

The news agency said the bank also cut by one percentage point its interest rates on deposits held by non-resident (expatriate) Indians, to 16 percent in the case of non-repatriable deposits and 14 percent on rupee deposits with a maturity period of two years or more.
